import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    static int n, t;
    static int[][] cap, sci;
    static int[][][] maze;
    static boolean[][][][][] dp;
    static int[] head, to, w, next;
    static int cnt;
    static int st, ed;
    static int[] d, now;
    static boolean[][] vis;
    static final int[][] dir = {{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}};

    static void addedge(int u, int v, int weight) {
        to[cnt] = v;
        w[cnt] = weight;
        next[cnt] = head[u];
        head[u] = cnt++;
        to[cnt] = u;
        w[cnt] = 0;
        next[cnt] = head[v];
        head[v] = cnt++;
    }

    static boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(d, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(s);
        now[s] = head[s];
        d[s] = 1;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = next[i]) {
                int v = to[i];
                int weight = w[i];
                if (d[v] != 0 || weight == 0) continue;
                d[v] = d[u] + 1;
                now[v] = head[v];
                q.add(v);
                if (v == t) return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int dinic(int x, int t, int flow) {
        if (x == t) return flow;
        int rest = flow;
        for (int i = now[x]; i != -1 && rest > 0; i = next[i]) {
            int v = to[i];
            int weight = w[i];
            if (weight > 0 && d[v] == d[x] + 1) {
                int k = dinic(v, t, Math.min(rest, weight));
                if (k == 0) d[v] = 0;
                w[i] -= k;
                w[i ^ 1] += k;
                rest -= k;
            }
            now[x] = i;
        }
        return flow - rest;
    }

    static int solve(int st, int ed) {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfs(st, ed)) {
            int flow;
            while ((flow = dinic(st, ed, INF)) > 0) {
                ans += flow;
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int get_id(int x, int y, int k) {
        return (x - 1) * n + y + k * n * n;
    }

    static void dfs(int x, int y, int xx, int yy, int step) {
        vis[xx][yy] = true;
        dp[step][x][y][xx][yy] = true;
        if (step >= t || maze[step][xx][yy] != 0) return;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            int nx = xx + dir[k][0];
            int ny = yy + dir[k][1];
            if (nx <= 0 || ny <= 0 || nx > n || ny > n) continue;
            if (vis[nx][ny]) continue;
            if (maze[step][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
            dfs(x, y, nx, ny, step + 1);
        }
    }

    static void init() {
        // propagate maze
        for (int time = 1; time <= t; time++) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
                    if (maze[time - 1][x][y] != 0) {
                        maze[time][x][y] = maze[time - 1][x][y];
                    } else {
                        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                            int xx = x + dir[k][0];
                            int yy = y + dir[k][1];
                            if (xx <= 0 || yy <= 0 || xx > n || yy > n) continue;
                            if (maze[time - 1][xx][yy] == 2) {
                                maze[time][x][y] = 2;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        // dfs for each scientist
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int a = 1; a <= n; a++) Arrays.fill(vis[a], false);
                    dfs(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        // propagate dp
        for (int i = 1; i <= t; i++) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
                    for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; xx++) {
                        for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; yy++) {
                            dp[i][x][y][xx][yy] |= dp[i - 1][x][y][xx][yy];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        int maxNodes = 2 * n * n + 3;
        int maxEdges = 2 * (n * n + n * n + n * n * n * n) + 10;
        head = new int[maxNodes];
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        to = new int[maxEdges];
        w = new int[maxEdges];
        next = new int[maxEdges];
        d = new int[maxNodes];
        now = new int[maxNodes];
        vis = new boolean[n + 1][n + 1];

        sci = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
        cap = new int[n + 1][n + 1];
        maze = new int[t + 1][n + 1][n + 1];
        dp = new boolean[t + 1][n + 1][n + 1][n + 1][n + 1];

        // read first n lines
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                char c = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                    sci[i][j] = c - '0';
                } else if (c == 'Y') {
                    maze[0][i][j] = 1;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    maze[0][i][j] = 2;
                }
            }
        }
        // read next n lines
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String s = sc.next();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                char c = s.charAt(j - 1);
                if (Character.isDigit(c)) {
                    cap[i][j] = c - '0';
                }
            }
        }

        st = 2 * n * n + 1;
        ed = 2 * n * n + 2;

        init();

        // build graph
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    addedge(st, get_id(i, j, 0), sci[i][j]);
                }
                if (cap[i][j] != 0) {
                    addedge(get_id(i, j, 1), ed, cap[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int x = 1; x <= n; x++) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
                for (int xx = 1; xx <= n; xx++) {
                    for (int yy = 1; yy <= n; yy++) {
                        if (sci[x][y] != 0 && cap[xx][yy] != 0 && dp[t][x][y][xx][yy]) {
                            addedge(get_id(x, y, 0), get_id(xx, yy, 1), INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(solve(st, ed));
        sc.close();
    }
}
